text:
maria: quick sync — doing a small cleanup pass on Optimize docs: a couple broken links, outdated SDK snippets (node + py), and the quant name mapping. planning to bundle tiny fixes into one PR if owners are available.

kevin: i can take the snippets. drop the file paths and i'll update to the new client API.

maria: files are: docs/optimize/snippets/kv-prefetch-example.md, docs/optimize/recipes/batching.md, docs/optimize/migration/quant-mapping.md. the node example in kv-prefetch uses old callbacks.

kevin: i'll convert node to async/await and fix param names. sample i'll use: 

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const r = await client.optimize.generate({
  model: 'redwood/latency-v1',
  input: 'summarize:',
  optimize: { batchSize: 4, kvPrefetch: true }
});
console.log(r.text);
```

anya: migration doc still mentions "quant-lite". we standardized to q4_0/q5_0/q8_0. i'll add a compact mapping + short advisory to run a quick eval after migrating.

maria: please add a one-line warning about tokenizer/profile mismatches.

anya: done and pushed to my branch. mapping: quant-lite -> q4_0, quant-pro -> q5_0. tiny note added.

sam: i'll run the playground smoke for batch=4 vs 8 and kv prefetch to capture median and p95 numbers for batching.md's example table. command i'll run: 

```bash
python -m redwood.tools.optimize_smoke --profile q4_0 --batch 4 --runs 10
```

sam: quick results: batch4 median ~170ms/token, batch8 median ~210ms/token, throughput ~1.8x at batch8. kv prefetch reduces repeated-token work ~30% on our test set.

kevin: perfect, i'll include sam's numbers with a note "results vary by model/seq-length". updating python snippet too. 

maria: docs-bot — can you rerun linkcheck for the optimize subtree? i saw an internal-only bench link in quant-mapping.

.docs-bot: Linkcheck: 1 failing link found in docs/optimize/migration/quant-mapping.md -> /internal/bench/q5_perf (404). Recommendation: remove or replace with public summary.

maria: decision: remove internal link and add a short public-facing perf summary. i'll open a single PR bundling snippet fixes, mapping, and linkfix. will ping for reviews.

kevin: will review when you ping.

docs-bot: PR opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4507 — checks queued: snippet-lint, linkcheck, unit-tests.
